services.name: Walking Tour
services.desc: Step into the shadows of Sag Harbor this October, where a simple walking tour will become something far more chilling. Led by Annette Hinkle, a Whaling Museum board member, what began as a collection of folkloric local legends has evolved over the years into a tapestry of truly firsthand ghost stories - tales shared by residents and friends who swear they’ve experienced the unexplained. The walking tour will begin and end at the Whaling Museum and stop in front of various homes and businesses around the Main Street area where tales will be told.
